answer: Miscellaneous >> Dua (Supplications) Question ID: 18546 Country: India Title: Dua to get proper match for marriage Question: Assalam Alaikum, 1.my daughter is of a mariageable age,we are in the process of finding a suitable match for her since past 2 years .many propasals have also beem coming bt noting seems to get fixed.everything stops in the very initial stages .please suggest us any dua or what should we do.please give the best dua for marriage. thank you Answer ID: 18546 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 25/25L=1431) You should recite ya Latif ya Wadood 1111 times after Isha Salah with durood 11 times and 11 times after. In-sh-Allah, you will soon come across a perfect match. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
